subject: Canonicalization of Admin Events for Third-Party Review — export shape & proofing
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@healtech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Intake <legal@healtech.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: admin event evidence + provenance for SIG review

Hi Monica,

Per our SIG/CAIQ intake the reviewer is asking for a packaged set of admin-event logs showing: who performed privileged actions, timestamps (with timezone), the pre- and post-actor context (resource id), and a cryptographic manifest or checksum. They also want guidance on retention (what you keep for 90/365 days) and the exact export format — prefer JSON lines or CSV?

Can Redwood provide:
- a short spec of the export shape we should expect,
- a sample of the first 3 lines (sanitized),
- how you attest export integrity (signed manifest/HMAC), and
- recommended retention language we can include in the SIG response.

We need this for the external auditor next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Security Operations, HealTech
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@healtech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin event evidence + provenance for SIG review

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. TL;DR: we can produce a signed, per-window evidence bundle with JSONL events, an HMAC-signed manifest.csv, and optional per-event signatures for elevated actions. Below are the practical pieces and a sanitized sample.

What we log (canonical event fields):
- event_id (uuid)
- occurred_at (ISO8601, UTC)
- actor (internal_user_id / service_id)
- actor_display (email)
- action (enum: ADMIN_LOGIN, ROLE_CHANGE, API_KEY_CREATE, MODEL_DEPLOY, DATA_EXPORT, etc.)
- target_resource (type:id)
- request_id (trace id)
- prev_state_summary (short text, optional)
- new_state_summary (short text, optional)
- reason/notes (if provided)
- geo (ip, geo_country)
- audit_tags (list)

Retention basics:
- Administrative events: rolling 365 days by default (can be shortened to 90 for specific customers via contract).
- Immutable snapshots (attested bundles) retained for 2 years for customers who request export-once evidence.

Export options and integrity:
- Shape: JSONL (one canonicalized JSON object per line) is recommended — easier to map to SIG fields.
- Compression: gzipped tarball (.tar.gz) for transport.
- Manifest: CSV manifest with columns [file_name, sha256, event_count, window_start, window_end] + HMAC-SHA256 over manifest. We provide an HMAC key exchange step (KMS-backed) or PGP signing depending on your preference.
- Timestamps: all timestamps in occurred_at are normalized to UTC and include sub-second precision. We also include local_zone field when zone fidelity is requested.

Sanitized sample (three lines):
{"event_id":"a3f9d2f4-6b2c-4a4e-9d2a-0f1b2c3d4e5f","occurred_at":"2026-11-10T21:14:02.123Z","actor":"user:vanessa_ortiz","actor_display":"vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com","action":"ROLE_CHANGE","target_resource":"project:proj-42","request_id":"req-9b8f-1a2b"}
{"event_id":"b7e8d3a1-2c4b-4b6d-8a3c-1e2f3a4b5c6d","occurred_at":"2026-11-10T21:21:33.456Z","actor":"service:kv-cache","actor_display":"kv-cache@redwood.internal","action":"API_KEY_CREATE","target_resource":"key:dk-xyz-123","request_id":"req-1c2d-3e4f"}
{"event_id":"c1d2e3f4-5a6b-7c8d-9e0f-1234567890ab","occurred_at":"2026-11-11T02:05:12.000Z","actor":"user:monica_patel","actor_display":"monica.patel@redwood.com","action":"DATA_EXPORT","target_resource":"export:evidence-20261111","request_id":"req-xyz-999"}

Packaging/proofing options (pick one):
1) HMAC manifest (recommended): manifest.csv + SHA256 per-file; manifest HMAC signed with customer-shared HMAC key (KMS-managed).
2) PGP signed tarball: we sign the tarball with our deploy PGP key (for customers that require asymmetric verification).
3) Attested snapshot: we produce a timestamped snapshot with an auditor-visible manifest and store an attestation hash in an append-only ledger (longer lead time).

Next steps / quick ask from you:
- Which verification mode do you prefer (HMAC vs PGP)?
- Do you need local time zone fields in each event, or is UTC-only OK?
- Do you want the default 365-day retention or to note 90 days in the SIG response?

I can have a draft evidence bundle and manifest by Monday EOD if you confirm mode. Attaching a short export_instructions.pdf that outlines the handshake.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Compliance Solutions (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: admin event evidence + provenance for SIG review

Hi Samir — adding the engineering export notes so your auditor has clarity about how we produce and verify bundles. Quoted Monica below.

(attachment: admin_events_schema_v2.jsonl — sample schema file)

Engineering notes:
- Export windows: we recommend daily windows (00:00–23:59 UTC) for size and replayability.
- Ordering: events are canonicalized by occurred_at then event_id. This gives deterministic file ordering and stable manifest checksums.
- PII redaction: we can redact actor_display for customers who require, but actor (internal_user_id) remains present for linkage. Note: redaction reduces auditability — call it out in the SIG answer.
- Delivery: SFTP or presigned S3 URL. The tarball will include: events/2026-11-10.jsonl.gz, manifest.csv, checksums.sig (HMAC), and readme.txt.
- HMAC rotation: we provide a one-time HMAC key exchange (via KMS-encrypted envelope). For long-running customers we can rotate monthly with a new envelope.

If you give us HMAC as preferred, Monica and I will stage a signed sample bundle and upload to the Drive link (below) for your auditor.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

— Samir
